A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

intramuscular E2 is the most important hormone in the strength and power regulation, whereas DHEA is the most important precursor of muscle‐produced E2 and DHT is the most potent androgen in skeletal muscle.

intramuscular E2 and its precursors, T and DHT, are associated with skeletal strength and power in both premenopausal and postmenopausal women.
